The *Gharakapotaṅgapañha* ("The House-Pigeon", Mil 7.6.4) is a short section within the seventh division of the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. Like other texts in this division, it explores qualities associated with an animal or object—here, the domestic or house-pigeon—applied as allegorical lessons for Buddhist monastic practice [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral notes a thematic reference or mention connecting this text with the *Cūḷanāradajātaka* (Ja 477) [SuttaCentral].

DharmaNexus also records a low-scoring machine alignment with the Chinese *Madhyama Āgama* (T 26, scroll 44) [DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records three modern translations in three languages [SuttaCentral].
